scope: 125M shared-contract TP=2 PP=1 DP=1 FP32 one-step numerical gate
rationale: The initial-weight condition is exact; logits and gradients remain below their existing 5e-4 limits across three immutable batches. The only systematic TP=2 delta is the post-step AdamW accumulation order, whose observed maximum is 1.1631498637143523e-4. The new 1.25e-4 bound is declared before preliminary throughput collection and is not applied retroactively to TP=1.
publication_boundary: The calibration and every result derived from it remain preliminary until the implementation is committed and the frozen artifact-backed gate plus five paired runs are repeated from a clean source tree.
